summary: Introduces creating, calibrating, running and reviewing Grafana Assistant Watchers.

needs.description: grafana-assistant-app installed and Assistant enabled on the stack, with Watchers feature available.
needs.evidence: requirements plugin-enabled:grafana-assistant-app; "Grafana Assistant enabled on your stack"

needs.description: Test user holds grafana-assistant-app.watcher-agents read, create, write, delete plus plugins.app:access.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Watchers permissions list

needs.description: Prometheus data source (grafanacloud-*-prom) queryable from Explore and selectable in the Datasources picker.
Metrics returning results for `count by (job) (up == 1)` representing a real service; calibration needs validated non-empty queries.
needs.evidence: formfill "count by (job) (up == 1)"; Before you begin: queries that return no data can stop calibration

needs.description: Assistant backend (LLM quota/service account) functional so calibration and Run now complete and produce run history.

reviewNotes: Calibration and run results depend on the Assistant LLM backend and may be slow or nondeterministic.
